name: explore-model
description: Pins the model that background recon subagents run on. An agent.spawn hook sets the Explore subagent's model to haiku, so a session driven by an expensive model stops billing its codebase searches at that tier, without shadowing the built-in agent definition and without the CLAUDE.md load a replacement definition would cost.

model.title: Model for the pinned agents
model.description: The model alias or id the named agents run on, e.g. "haiku" or "sonnet". Prefer an alias: it tracks whichever model currently answers to that name, where a dated id stops applying the day the next one ships. Set "inherit" to register no hook at all, which leaves every spawn as Claude Code resolves it.

agents.title: Agents to pin
agents.description: The subagent types this applies to, by the name the Agent tool resolves. Only agents whose work is read-only recon belong here: a pinned agent runs on the model above whatever its own definition asks for.

notice.title: Announce each pin
notice.description: Attach a one-line notice to each spawn the hook pins. Off by default, since the point of the hook is to be invisible; turn it on to confirm it is loaded and firing.
